newsitem.title: FINLAND: Tamro says Jan-Aug sales rose 19 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Tamro says Jan-Aug sales rose 19 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Finnish pharmaceuticals wholesaler Tamro-Yhtyma Oy said in a statement on Tuesday its January-August sales increased 19 percent year-on-year to 8.18 billion markka.
The group's pharmaceutials sales increased 20 percent to 7.60 billion markka.
Tamro's market share in Finland rose to 62 percent from 61 percent in the year-ago period, the company said. In Sweden, its market share fell one percentage point to 62 percent in January-July.
